niche.habitat: Fracture intersections, 1.0–2.0 km depth, multi-gradient zones
niche.diet: Filter-feeds dissolved Fe(II)/sulfate, hosts chemosynthetic archaea in symbiosis
niche.active: Diurnal/nocturnal analog tied to 56-hour tidal cycle

body: Porous, branching tube-structure, central processing chamber

chains.trait: Porous silica-carbonate filtration tubes capture particulates
links: Molecular diffusion moves scent 1 cm per day

observe: Flow reverses to flush clogged channels

journal.en: They build cities of dust and breath.
